# `company.ap_obligation_keys`

Stable vendor payables; retired ordinals are never reused and a correction never moves one.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1, unique with transaction_id + id | ix_ap_obligation_keys_vendor | — | Stable ULID of this payable; an application names this, never a revision. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with transaction_id + id, unique with transaction_id + ordinal | — | transactions.id | Purchase document that permanently owns this payable. |
| `ordinal` | BIGINT | no | — | unique with transaction_id + ordinal | — | — | One-based payable ordinal within the document; a bill has exactly one. |
| `vendor_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_ap_obligation_keys_vendor | vendors.id | Vendor a settlement must match exactly. |
| `ap_account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_ap_obligation_keys_vendor | accounts.id | Payable account a settlement must match exactly. |
| `currency` | VARCHAR(3) | no | — | — | — | — | Home currency a settlement must match exactly. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this purchase history was written. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that wrote this purchase history. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that wrote this purchase history. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this payable. |
